packageRules.description: These are used only for the internal app, will be managed manually.
Pin Ruby version to last known working version for fastlane compatibility.

customManagers.description: Keep the spmForKmp remotePackageVersion literals in Gradle in sync with the generated Package.swift, so a single Renovate PR bumps both. depName (owner/repo) and datasource (github-tags) match the built-in swift manager, which groups the two files onto the same branch.
